'''Tenn''', nicknamed '''Peewo''' by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gett]], was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] stationed in the ops room of the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class Assault Ship]] ''[[Fearless]]'' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], where [[Gender/Legends|he]] acted as the principle [[Weapons officer/Legends|weapons officer]] for [[Improcco Company]]. He aided [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] and [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] Gett in planning the rescue of [[Omega Squad]], by finding the optimum fire solution for the ''Fearless'' as it decelerated out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Tenn fired two [[Ion torpedo/Legends|ion torpedos]] at a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], destroying it and saving the lives of both [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta]] and Omega Squad.<ref name="zero" />
